nodes.question: How can gametophytes be preserved as genetic resources according to the study?
nodes.answer: Gametophytes can be vegetatively cultured (cloned) and preserved as genetic resources.

nodes.question: How are Ae. tauschii and T. turgidum represented in germplasm collections?
nodes.answer: Both Ae. tauschii and T. turgidum are among the most represented in germplasm collections, which host thousands of accessions of these species.
